description: This file defines the ModuleScreenHelper class which provides static methods to retrieve and reset the current module and screen information based on HTTP request data within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: ModuleScreenHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to manage the current module and screen state based on HTTP request path.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current module and screen information based on the current HTTP request path.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Fetches the current HTTP request object from the service container.

methods.name: resetCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Resets the cached module and screen information to null.
